hooks.text: 战斗中收集材料和货币解锁武器与驱魔能力，数十类武器配方需靠实战取得后自由组合
hooks.excerpt: Collect materials and currency during battle to unlock new weapons and Exorcism Powers. Your arsenal includes: A lightsaber straight out of a sci-fi film Sacred relic weapons born from ancient legends Even an adorable cat-themed weapon!? Combine dozens of weapon types to craft your own build. But nothing comes for free—every recipe must be earned through combat.
